note: Set A's seven claims are all faithful and correctly bound, including the 47,402.91 N·m torque saturation, the 15,000 N·m/s rate limit, and the 1173.7 rpm rated generator speed. Set B covers the same ground but adds several redundant duplicates (the torque saturation and blade-pitch goal each appear twice, rated speed twice) and one unsupported claim: it asserts a generator torque of 50,000 N·m at ~1,200 rpm from Figure 7-2, where the variable-speed curve is well below 50,000 N·m and the caption quote supports no such value. B's 'baseline' condition on rated speed is also a misbound condition. A is therefore cleaner and more accurate.
